adoption: unpublished complete static common Program development HIR; no Runtime or wire adoption

constructorParameters.argumentType: raw argument capacity, including undefined for a default; binding.type retains the initialized declaration
constructorParameters.evaluation: base ordinary instance fields, left-to-right conditional parameter initialization, parameter properties, body; derived parameters precede body and super
constructorParameters.scope: original parameter scope excludes body declarations; only the accepted official Source subset is admitted

environments.identity: Stable layout owner/parent and sorted stable capture slots; raw binding/range remains provenance
environments.instances: Activation instances occur only in actual SSA flow, never in HIR or Published

hosts.identity: Owned ambient declarations preserve original binding, selected structural signature and UTF16 anchors; never source functions
hosts.semantics: hostContext is an independently verified VM/AOT implementation-bound Counter contract plus exact BuildIdentity/BuildInputSet, not Source authority

identity.semantic: stable declaration keys and complete labelled type shape; excludes bodies, field initializers, ranges and current source digests

ownership: strict cold Source reconstruction; derived DTO never authorizes itself
